biggest_catch: The $1,000 figure is real but requires depositing $200,000-$499,999; an ordinary $1,000 deposit earns only $50.
catches: The $1,000 tier requires a $200,000-$499,999 deposit within 60 days of account opening; the realistic first tier is $50 for $1,000-$4,999.
You must enter promo code OFFER26 during account opening — the code can be used only once for one account, and enrolling any other way earns $0.
Account must be opened by 10/31/26 and funded within 60 calendar days of opening; at least $1,000 must be deposited to earn any reward.
Offer is for new E*TRADE clients only, opening an eligible new account within the enrollment period.
The page headline says 'Get up to $1,500' but the tier table continues past $1,500 all the way to $10,000 for $5M+ — the headline understates the table.

c3.evidence: No fee to open or enroll; page states '$0 commissions on online US-listed stock, ETF, mutual fund, and option trades' and 'no account minimums or maintenance fees.'

steps: Go to the official E*TRADE promo page https://us.etrade.com/promo/brokerage?icid=et-brokerage-hero-learn-how and click 'Open a brokerage account'.
Choose the brokerage account type and complete the online application (about 10 minutes) — or apply by phone at 800-387-2331.
Enter promo code OFFER26 in the online application when opening the account (required — the code works once for one account). Account must be opened by 10/31/26.
Save the enrollment confirmation email E*TRADE sends after you enroll in the offer.
Fund the new account within 60 calendar days of account opening. Deposit at least $1,000 to earn any reward; $200,000-$499,999 earns the $1,000 tier (realistic: $1,000-$4,999 earns $50).
Keep the account open; the cash credit is paid within seven business days after the 60-day funding period expires.
timing: Rewards paid within seven business days following the expiration of the 60-day funding period.

weasel_words.quote: Headline 'Get up to $1,500' while the official tier table on the same page pays up to $10,000 for $5M+ deposits.
